symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: A vector space over $F$ on which the bilinear form is defined.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ be a vector space over $F$, with a bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ on $X$.

symbols.name: bilinear form
symbols.meaning: The bilinear form on $X$ whose value $\langle\xi,\eta\rangle$ defines orthogonality.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ be a vector space over $F$, with a bilinear form $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ on $X$.

symbols.name: larger label
symbols.meaning: The larger of the two labels on an edge, which contains the smaller label $U$.
symbols.quote: For such an edge, write $U\subseteq W$, where $U$ is the smaller label and $W$ the larger.

relations.quote: The orthogonal complement $U^\perp$ of a subspace $U$ (a subset closed under addition and under multiplication by scalars) is defined by a [bilinear form](bilinear-form.md): it is the set of vectors that the form sends to zero against every vector of $U$.
